slot.company: recorded for the whole company — entering a site invoice would count this month twice

reason.unattributedOne: 1 entry is recorded for the whole company rather than a site, so they close no site's month.
reason.unattributedMany: {count} entries are recorded for the whole company rather than a site, so they close no site's month.
reason.outOfScopeOne: 1 entry is at a site that did not exist yet at the end of {year}, so there is no row for them.
reason.outOfScopeMany: {count} entries are at a site that did not exist yet at the end of {year}, so there is no row for them.
reason.nonMonthlyOne: 1 entry is not reported as a single month, so none of them stands in for a monthly invoice.
reason.nonMonthlyMany: {count} entries are not reported as a single month, so none of them stands in for a monthly invoice.

reviewNoteOne: 1 invoice is keyed in but still waiting for review, so this category is not finished yet.
reviewNoteMany: {count} invoices are keyed in but still waiting for review, so this category is not finished yet.
unreviewedOne: 1 entry is keyed in but nobody has reviewed it yet, so this category is not finished.
unreviewedMany: {count} entries are keyed in but nobody has reviewed them yet, so this category is not finished.
duplicateOne: {list} is recorded both at a site and for the whole company, so that month is already counted twice in the emissions total. Removing one of each pair is the only way to resolve it.
duplicateMany: {list} are recorded both at a site and for the whole company, so those months are already counted twice in the emissions total. Removing one of each pair is the only way to resolve it.

warn.siteAfterYear: This site is not part of {year}'s {required} invoices — it was created after that year ended.
warn.wholeCompany: This entry is recorded for the whole company, so it closes none of the {required} site invoices tracked here.
warn.notMonthlyQuarterly: A quarterly entry closes no invoice slot — the rule counts one invoice per month.
warn.notMonthlyAnnual: An annual entry closes no invoice slot — the rule counts one invoice per month.
warn.companyHoldsMonth: {period} {year} is already recorded for the whole company. Keying a site invoice for it as well would count that month twice — both rows feed the emissions total.
warn.sitesHoldMonth: {period} {year} is already recorded at {sites}. A whole-company entry for the same month would count it twice — both rows feed the emissions total.
